messages:
maria: Quick sync after the KV-tail postmortem. We need owners for remediation tasks, and concrete test additions: regression suite entries, targeted prompt vectors, load profile, and a chaos drill.

kevin: I can pick up regression automation and the prompt vectors. Plan: assemble a focused promptset that hits hot-key ranges + small key skew patterns. Target PR by Tue (2025-04-15).

lee: Ill take the load profile + chaos drill. Proposal: two load patterns (steady 200rps sustained and a 10m spike 100->800rps) and a partition scenario that isolates a single replica for 30s. Ill sketch a k6 job and a chaos-runbook.

maria: Good. Who wires these into CI and the canary gating? We want an automatic break on regressions that increase tail latency or kv-miss ratio.

dana: Ops can add the canary job. I suggest gating on absolute 95th and 99.9th latency thresholds and a delta on kv-miss > 8% vs baseline. Also add a small perf-budget annotation on PRs.

kevin: For the promptset, Ill include 100 vectors: 60 real-session-sampled keys (sanitized), 40 synthetic high-contention keys. Will store in tests/promptsets/kv_tail.json and include metadata for baseline metrics.

lee: Chaos sketch (will replace iptables with safe chaos tooling):
```
# chaos harness outline
run_load(pattern="spike", rps=[100,800], duration=600)
wait(30)
isolate_node(node="replica-3", duration=30)
observe(metrics=["kv_hit_rate","p99_latency","cpu"])
```
Will make a safe-run flag to avoid running in prod by default.

maria: Nice. Add alerts if nightly regression fails 2 consecutive runs, and page oncall if canary fails on deploy. Also, add a rollback playbook link in the PR description.

dana: I created INF-5007 to track this work and assigned kevin+lee. Due: 2025-04-20.

ops-bot: Created INF-5007: "KV tail remediation + tests" assigned to kevin,lee, due 2025-04-20.

kevin: One question: should we run the full reg-suite nightly or a short smoke on weekdays and full on weekends? Cost tradeoff.

maria: Tradeoffs: run smoke every weekday (fast vectors) and full nightly on the infra runners, with an extended weekly soak (3h) on staging. That should catch regressions and limit cost.

lee: Ill draft the chaos drill checklist for the oncall team: pre-checks, metrics dashboard links, abort conditions, and recovery steps. Will post the checklist to #runbooks.

kevin: Ill also add KV instrumentation hooks to the tests so we capture hit/miss per key and percentiles.

maria: Great. Please tag me in PRs and put a short summary in INF-5007 when complete. Planning brief for execs: single owner per workstream, clear timelines, and CI gating.

dana: Will add executive summary to INF-5007 and a Google doc with timelines.

maria: Thanks all. Lets aim to have test PRs and the canary job in place before the next deploy. :thumbsup:
